title: ISL Makes Historic Imphal Debut as NorthEast United FC Face Sporting Club Delhi at Khuman Lampak
summary: Manipur hosts its first-ever ISL match as NorthEast United FC face Sporting Club Delhi at Khuman Lampak Main Stadium, Imphal, on November 24 at 7:30 PM.
body:
Imphal, November 24, 2026: Manipur is set to witness its first-ever Indian Super League (ISL) match on Tuesday as NorthEast United FC take on Sporting Club Delhi at the Khuman Lampak Main Stadium in Imphal. The match is scheduled to kick off at 7:30 PM IST.

The fixture marks a significant moment for football in Manipur, which has produced several prominent footballers for Indian football. It will also be the first time NorthEast United FC use Imphal as their home venue for an ISL match.

The occasion carries special significance for the club's Manipuri players, including Soraisham Dinesh Singh, Tondonba Ngasepam, Danny Laishram Meitei, Saikhom Thoiba Singh and Buanthanglun Samte. The players will have an opportunity to represent their club in front of their families, friends and home supporters.

Speaking at the pre-match press conference in Imphal, defender Soraisham Dinesh Singh expressed his happiness at returning to play in his hometown.

"I'm so happy to be home. This is my hometown. Let's see what tomorrow brings. I hope we win," he said.

**NorthEast United Look to Bounce Back**

NorthEast United FC enter the fixture following a 1–0 defeat against FC Goa in their previous league match in Guwahati. The result ended their unbeaten start to the season, leaving the Highlanders with 11 points from six matches.

Head coach Juan Pedro Benali said the team was focused on moving forward and improving its performance rather than dwelling on the previous defeat.

"The Goa game is in the past. We can't change the result, but we can change some of the things we do on the pitch," Benali said during the pre-match press conference.

**Unbeaten Sporting Club Delhi Pose a Challenge**

Sporting Club Delhi arrive in Imphal unbeaten in their last four matches. The team recorded victories against Mumbai City FC and Inter Kashi before playing out a 2–2 draw against East Bengal FC.

Delhi's attacking players Carlos Fortes and Juan Peña have scored three league goals each and will be among the players NorthEast United need to watch closely.

The previous meeting between the two sides in April ended in a 3–0 victory for Delhi. However, NorthEast United will draw confidence from their two league victories over the opposition during the 2024–25 season, when they scored nine goals across the two encounters.

With both sides seeking points and Manipur preparing to host its first ISL fixture, Tuesday's match is expected to be a memorable occasion for local football supporters. For the Manipuri players in the NorthEast United squad, it will also be a special opportunity to play top-flight club football in front of a home crowd.
author: Mirror Lilong Desk
